summary: Compassionate appointment eligibility under 1998 Scheme; financial criteria requiring family income less than 60% of deceased employee's salary; educational qualification (matriculation) required within 4 years; High Court wrongly restored Trial Court decree; appointment discretion not judicially enforceable; compassionate claim not maintainable as right; scheme terms binding, court cannot rewrite policy.
legal_provisions_cited: Kunti Tiwary vs. General Manager (D&PB), (2004) 7 SCC 271
Balbir Kaur vs. Steel Authority of India Ltd., (2000) 6 SCC 493
N.C. Santhosh vs. State of Karnataka, (2019) 7 SCC 617
State of Himachal Pradesh vs. Parkash Chand, (2019) 4 SCC 285
State of Himachal Pradesh vs. Shashi Kumar, (2019) 3 SCC 653
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court decree quashed; dismissal of compassionate appointment restored.
